data.body: Remediation verified 2026-09-10 09:58, no reboot needed: operator sudo-killed fseventsd (SIP blocks launchctl kickstart; direct signal works, launchd respawns). New fseventsd PID 21316 at 10.9MB RSS (was 28.5GB RSS / 107GB footprint). Swap 67.0/68.6GB -> 18.4/19.4GB and draining; free RAM ~0.1GB -> ~52GB; compressor 65GB -> 39GB. Additional finding for AC1: codex respawns MCP servers ON DEMAND when one dies (observed respawn at 09:57:12 after stale-stack kills), so (a) killing stale stacks is safe for live conversations, and (b) the config enabled=false only takes effect at ChatGPT.app restart — operator to relaunch the app when the current parallel session finishes. AC3 verification window starts now; mem-sentinel snapshots should confirm fseventsd stays <5GB over the week.
